definitions.explanation: The natural periodic state of rest in which the body recovers.

notes:
{睡眠|すいみん} is the formal/medical term for sleep.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡眠|すいみん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to get sleep)
- {睡眠|すいみん}⟦{不足|ぶそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧ (lack of sleep, sleep deprivation)
- {睡眠|すいみん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (sleep time, hours of sleep)
- {睡眠|すいみん}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ (sleep disorder)
- {睡眠|すいみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (sleep quality)
- {睡眠|すいみん}⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (sleeping pill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {睡眠|すいみん}: sleep (formal, medical term)
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧: sleep (poetic, literary)
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: to sleep (verb, everyday usage)
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep, to go to bed (more casual)
